description: This file defines the SugarEmailAddress class, which manages email addresses within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for handling email addresses related to users and contacts, validating email formats, saving and retrieving email addresses, managing primary and reply-to addresses, and rendering email address widgets. The class interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations on email address records and maintains relationships between email addresses and other beans (e.g., Users, Contacts). It also handles legacy support for email addresses and email address-related UI components.

classes.name: SugarEmailAddress
classes.description: A class for managing email addresses within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including adding, updating, retrieving, validating email addresses, and rendering email address widgets.

methods.name: handleLegacySave
methods.description: Handles legacy email address format support and populates email addresses from legacy bean fields.

methods.name: saveAtUserProfile
methods.description: Saves email addresses specific to user profile edits, validating the request and updating email address relationships accordingly.

methods.name: handleEmailSaveAtUserProfile
methods.description: Handles saving an individual email address for user profile, updating the database, and setting primary/reply-to flags.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Validates if a given email address string conforms to RFC standards.

methods.name: isUserProfileEditViewPageSaveAction
methods.description: Checks if the current request corresponds to a user profile save action.

methods.name: populateLegacyFields
methods.description: Populates legacy email fields (email1, email2) in a bean based on stored addresses.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Deprecated. Calls saveEmail(); used for legacy single email save.

methods.name: saveEmail

methods.name: getAddressesByGUID

methods.name: getEmailAddressWidgetEditView

methods.name: getEmailAddressWidgetDetailView

methods.name: confirmOptIn
